# Handover 1.1 — Keep moving troops inside their validated domain

**What landed**

`872b437 Keep troop movement inside the interior` restricts distance-field
traversal and troop destinations to `x=1..238, y=1..158`. An interior source
seeds distance zero; a boundary cursor seeds its cardinal interior neighbours at
distance one; a corner cursor leaves the hostile field with no reachable interior
cells, so enemies wait. Additions to `tests/core/survival-waves.test.ts` cover the
exact `(5,0)` / `(4,1)` case moving east to `(5,1)` with a snapshot round-trip,
all four edges, all four corners, and partition invariance with occupancy.
`tests/core/survival-allies.test.ts` covers allies advancing to a top-edge rally
while the cursor sits on the boundary. `docs/survival-coverage.md` records the
interior-only contract and the new regression examples.

**Landmark drift**

The plan's `inWorld` and movement line numbers have shifted by roughly 10 lines
after the helper and test additions. `distanceField` is now near
`src/core/world.ts:1276`; the ally/hostile candidate checks are near 1338 and
1371. The plan's `inWorld` landmark still exists but is now only used to reject
sources outside the world; interior checks use the new `inInterior` helper.

**Deviations from the work order**

No public interface changed. I added one private `inInterior(x, y)` helper and
used it in the existing interior validators (`troopPosition`, `rallyCell`,
`rallyProblem`, `insideInterior`) to keep their behavior identical and their
domain consistent. The plan only required movement and BFS changes; this reuse
is behavior-preserving. I added the ally boundary example as a second movement
suite example.

**What the next session must know**

- Cursor navigation still reaches every boundary cell and is untouched.
- Boundary sources generally are virtual sources, but rally and enemy sources
  are already validated interior cells, so in practice only the cursor can be a
  boundary source.
- Corner cursors produce an all-`-1` hostile field; the existing `<= 0` wait
  check keeps enemies still. Adjacent-enemy and adjacent-cursor combat holds are
  unchanged.
- `direnv exec . just verify` passed: 292 core tests, 106 browser tests across
  both projects, typecheck, contract checks, first-playable completion and
  benchpress lint. No flake change, so `just check-nix` was not run.

**Open problems**

None.
